sets.relationshipLabel: a category and a kind within it
sets.explanation: Cinnamon is a spice and pistachio is a nut — each pair names a broad category and one member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw source processed into the traded spice
sets.explanation: Each pair moves from the raw plant part to the processed product sold as spice or flavoring.

sets.relationshipLabel: a creature and the carrying gear that belongs to it
sets.explanation: A saddlebag belongs on a camel and a pannier on a donkey — each animal paired with the gear built to ride it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of one span
sets.explanation: Planting begins what harvest ends, and opening begins what closing ends — each pair marks the two edges of a single stretch of time.
